verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API spec is a fair question for a framework that ships a Mastra server and standalone endpoints, so the axis applies. However, every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no doc mentions a downloadable spec. The llms.txt and docs.md files are LLM-oriented documentation, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
